stories.fallback: On June 23, Chicago had matched a whole season of wins. Win 42 came on June 26. By August 9, Chicago had passed 2025’s 60 wins, too. The 2026 finish: 84–78—43 more wins than two years earlier.
stories.summary: Three seasons. First 2024, then 2025, then 2026. Watch Chicago match a whole season of wins before halfway through the year.
stories.title: A Whole Season of Wins. By June.

stories.fallback: Ball A was caught. Ball B cleared the right-field wall. The shorter swing put a run on the board. Where a ball goes matters as much as how far it goes.
stories.summary: Two Vilade swings: 356 feet and 340 feet. Guess which one left the yard, then take it around all 30 parks.
stories.title: The home run that needed this stadium
